home
家
What makes a place feel like home to you?
The smell of my mom's cooking makes any place feel like home. When I sleep somewhere else, having my own pillow also helps me feel at home.
媽媽煮菜的香味，會讓任何地方都有家的感覺。在別的地方過夜時，帶著自己的枕頭也能讓我覺得像在家一樣。
house
房子
What kind of house would you like to live in someday?
I would like to live in a small house near the mountains. It would have a little garden where I could grow vegetables.
我以後想住在靠近山邊的小房子。房子有一個小花園，我可以在那裡種菜。
room
房間
You have one spare room. How would you use it?
I would turn the spare room into a reading space. A small desk could also make it useful for guests.
我會把多出來的房間整理成閱讀空間。放張小書桌，客人來住時也用得到。
kitchen
廚房
What would you change to make the kitchen in your home nicer to use?
I would add more lights to our kitchen because it is a little dark. I would also put a small table there so my family could eat breakfast together.
我們家的廚房有點暗，所以我會多裝一些燈。我也會在那裡放一張小桌子，讓家人可以一起吃早餐。
window
窗戶
Would you prefer a window facing a street or a garden?
I would choose a window facing a garden. The quieter view would help me relax after a busy day.
我會選面向花園的窗戶。忙了一天後，安靜的景色能讓我放鬆。
doorway
門口
A delivery is blocking your doorway. What would you do?
I would move the package away from the doorway first. Then I would ask the courier to leave future deliveries beside it.
我會先把包裹移開，別擋住門口。再請快遞以後把東西放在旁邊。
table
桌子
How would you arrange a table for dinner with several friends?
I would move the table away from the wall. Everyone would have enough space to sit and pass dishes around.
我會把桌子移離牆邊。這樣大家坐得下，也方便互相傳菜。
chair
椅子
What matters when choosing a chair for working at home?
I need a chair that supports my back. I would try sitting in it before deciding to buy it.
我需要能支撐背部的椅子。決定購買前，我會先實際坐坐看。
bed
床
Your bed takes up most of a small bedroom. What could you change?
I would choose a bed with storage underneath. That would leave more floor space without losing a comfortable place to sleep.
我會選床底能收納的床。這樣能騰出地面空間，也不用犧牲睡覺的舒適度。
bathroom
浴室
How does your family share the bathroom on busy mornings?
We take turns using the bathroom on busy mornings. My dad goes first because he leaves the earliest, and I go after him.
早上很忙的時候，我們家會輪流用浴室。爸爸最早出門，所以他先用，我再接著用。
clean
清理
Guests are arriving soon. What would you clean first?
I would clean the bathroom and dining table first. Those are the places our guests will probably use most.
我會先清理浴室和餐桌。客人最可能用到的，就是這兩個地方。
repair
修理
Would you repair a damaged lamp or buy a replacement?
I would ask how much the repair would cost. If it were safe and affordable, I would keep the lamp.
我會先問修理要多少錢。只要修好後安全、價格也合理，我就會留下那盞燈。
noise
噪音
How would you handle noise from an apartment upstairs?
I would record when the noise usually happens. Then I would politely ask my neighbour whether we could find a solution.
我會記下噪音通常出現的時間。再客氣地問樓上鄰居，能不能一起想辦法。
quiet
安靜
Where would you create a quiet corner in your home?
I would make a quiet corner away from the television. A reading lamp and a comfortable seat would be enough.
我會在離電視遠一點的地方留個安靜角落。有盞閱讀燈和舒服的座位就夠了。
neighbour
鄰居
How would you introduce yourself to a new neighbour?
I would greet my new neighbour in the hallway. I could mention which apartment I live in and offer a friendly welcome.
我會在走廊主動向新鄰居打招呼。告訴他我住哪一戶，也歡迎他搬來。
rent
房租
If you go to university in another city, how would you keep your rent low?
I would share an apartment with a few classmates to keep the rent low. I could also live a little farther from campus and ride a bike to class.
我會和幾個同學合租公寓，讓房租低一點。我也可以住得離學校遠一點，再騎腳踏車去上課。
share
分擔
How would you share household chores fairly?
We could share the work by rotating the less popular chores. A visible list would make everyone's responsibilities clearer.
我們可以輪流分擔比較沒人想做的家事。把清單貼出來，也比較清楚各自要做什麼。
private
私人
How do you get some private time when you share a home with your family?
I tell my family that I need some private time after school. When my bedroom door is closed, they know I want to be alone for a while.
我會跟家人說放學後需要一點私人時間。我的房門關著時，他們就知道我想自己待一下。
space
空間
How could you make better use of a small living space?
I would use shelves to free up floor space. I would also keep only the things I actually use.
我會用層架騰出地面空間。也只留下自己真的會用到的東西。
comfortable
舒服
What helps overnight guests feel comfortable in your home?
Clean bedding and clear instructions help guests feel comfortable. I also show them where to find water and extra towels.
乾淨的寢具和清楚的說明，會讓客人住得舒服。我也會告訴他們水和備用毛巾在哪。
organize
整理
How would you organize a cupboard that everyone uses?
I would organize the cupboard by how often we use things. Everyday items would go on the easiest shelf to reach.
我會依使用頻率整理櫥櫃。每天用的東西，就放在最方便拿的那一層。
belong
屬於
What helps you feel that you belong in a new neighbourhood?
I feel I belong when local shopkeepers recognize me. Joining a regular community activity would help me meet more people too.
附近店家認得我時，我就會有屬於這裡的感覺。固定參加社區活動，也能多認識一些人。
move
搬家
What would you do first when preparing to move?
Before I move, I would sort my things into keep and donate piles. Packing less would make the whole day easier.
搬家前，我會先分好要留下和捐出的東西。東西少一點，搬起來就輕鬆多了。
furniture
家具
Would you buy new or second-hand furniture for a first apartment?
I would buy sturdy second-hand furniture for most rooms. I would inspect it carefully and measure the apartment before paying.
大部分房間，我會選結實的二手家具。付款前會仔細檢查，也先量好家裡的尺寸。
